name: W-nodes are symmetric
summary: Swapping two legs of a W-node (black vertex) gives the same W-node.
description:
The black vertices of the ZW-calculus are symmetric: swapping two of their legs with an ordinary swap does not change them (Rule 0 of Hadzihasanovic 2015, $sym_w$ of his thesis). This is what allows treating them as vertices of an undirected graph. In PyZX the outputs of a W-node are unordered, so this holds by construction.

The swap here is an ordinary swap; for the fermionic crossing see [W-nodes are symmetric under the crossing](../w-fermionic-symmetry/).
parameter_notes: Shown for a W-node with three outputs; holds for any number of legs.
unchecked_reason: both sides are the same PyZX graph: symmetry of the generator is built into the graph representation

also_in.location: Chapter 5, Section 5.2 (list of rules of the ZW calculus), rule $sym_w$
